eligible_assets.wardrobe_basis: The labourer's dress of the 1835 town (Patrick Mahoney's body: shirt, trousers, braces and a slouch hat), worn by a hand of a lake schooner at work on her deck (T-3612, L-vessels-3612). A working man's clothes ashore and afloat were one and the same; the cut, colours and fit stay reconstructed, and no seaman's dress is claimed for any man of any named vessel's crew, whom no record names.
